topics.label: Lecture introduction and learning outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: The subtopic introduces the lecture's scope on cancer evolution, the role of the microenvironment, and the key learning objectives.

topics.label: Clonal selection and epigenetic drivers in pre-malignant tissues
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how genetic mutations and epigenetic changes provide selective fitness advantages driving clonal expansion in early tissue lesions.

topics.label: Cell of origin and cancer stem cell hierarchy
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics investigate whether malignancies arise from tissue stem cells or committed progenitors using leukemia and intestinal crypt models.

topics.label: Microenvironmental and inflammatory promotion of tumor growth
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics demonstrate how external environmental exposures, chronic inflammation, and supportive stroma provide essential permissive signals for tumorigenesis and cancer maintenance.

topics.label: Methods for analyzing tumor evolution and spatial architecture
topics.groupedBecause: The subtopic outlines the genomic, transcriptomic, and spatial omics technologies used to map clonal evolution and cellular interactions within tumors.

topics.label: Integrated evolutionary model of cancer progression
topics.groupedBecause: The subtopic synthesizes how genetic mutations, cell-of-origin characteristics, and microenvironmental conditions jointly drive cancer development.

topics.label: Lecture closing
topics.groupedBecause: The subtopic wraps up the lecture and introduces the topic of the upcoming lecture.
